description: Proposal of Application Notice for a digital/data centre and manufacturing campus at East Airdrie (Drumshangie): data centres, gigafactory, research facilities, offices, electricity infrastructure, battery energy storage and ancillary uses (Classes 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10 and sui generis) on c.117.21 ha.
decision_notes: Reported by trade press as filed by 'an affiliate of UK potato-supplier Albert Bartlett'; some filings reportedly referenced an energy-from-waste facility alongside a data centre. Not verified on the council portal (portal unreachable from research environment).
